| Status | End-date behavior |
|---|---|
| Discharged, Completed, Discontinued | Preserve existing; set if missing |
| Cancelled, Entered in error | Clear |
| Planned, In progress, On hold | Clear |
| Unknown | Preserve existing; never generate |
